args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks after its deployment to production, showing elevated error rates (peaking at 18%) across all regions. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Next steps: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before any re-attempt at rollout.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy, failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** — the most recent release with a confirmed healthy production history — across all three regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which pages the on-call engineer and documents the root cause description, the rollback action, and next steps (investigating v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt).

No approval was needed for the rollback since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. The incident is open and the on-call engineer has been paged.
